translations.en:
Even among the many varieties
of goblin, those monsters
most like humans, this is
an unusual specimen. The
"nightmare" in its name comes
from its poisonous breath.
Perhaps those who dismissed
it as a mere goblin found that
breath gave them nightmares.
Once you know how it attacks,
however, it should not be a
particularly dangerous opponent.

translations.en:
It is said to be the mist
surrounding the city mingled
with the hatred of the dead.
Nothing human remains of
it. It has even forgotten to
resent its fleeting fate,
and seeks only to draw the
living over to its side.
Perhaps it is a tragic
creature that could only
have arisen in this city.
Dwell on sympathy, however,
and you will become the
material for the next monster.
